rules.sentence: The patient develops right lower quadrant abdominal pain, often with rebound tenderness and a tense, distended abdomen, in a setting of fever and neutropenia.
Watery diarrhea (often containing sloughed mucosa) and bacteremia are common, and bleeding may occur.
